```{r }

create_window <- function(df) {
  x_range <- range(df$Centroid.X.µm)
  y_range <- range(df$Centroid.Y.µm)
  owin(xrange = x_range, yrange = y_range)  # Create spatial window
}

create_ppp_list <- function(attn_cell, attn = 2){
  # attn 2 means all, 1 means high, 0 means low regions
  attn_cell_dataset <- attn_cell%>%
    # filter(dataset == !!dataset)%>%
    {if (attn == 1) filter(., attention_score >= 0.5) 
     else if (attn == 0) filter(., attention_score < 0.5) 
     else .}
  
  # str(attn_cell_dataset)

  
  attn_cell_dataset <- attn_cell_dataset %>%
    filter(Class %in% c("Lymphocyte", "Plasma")) %>%
    mutate(Class = "Lymph.Plasma") %>%
    bind_rows(attn_cell_dataset)

  attn_cell_dataset <- attn_cell_dataset %>%
    filter(Class %in% c("Eosinophil", "Lymphocyte", "Neutrophil", "Plasma")) %>%
    mutate(Class = "Immune") %>%
    bind_rows(attn_cell_dataset)
  
  attn_cell_dataset$Class <- as.factor(attn_cell_dataset$Class)
  attn_cell_dataset_images <- attn_cell_dataset %>%
    select(Image) %>%
    mutate(Image = as.character(Image))%>%
    unique()

  ppp_list <- attn_cell_dataset %>%
    group_by(Image) %>%
    group_map(~ {
      win <- create_window(.x)  # Create window for each slide
      ppp(x = .x$Centroid.X.µm, y = .x$Centroid.Y.µm, marks = .x$Class, window = win, checkdup=FALSE)
    })

  for (i in seq_along(ppp_list) ){
    ppp_list[[i]][["Image"]] = attn_cell_dataset_images$Image[i]
  }
  return(ppp_list)
}



```





```{r}
calculate_ripley <- function(ppp_obj, cell_type1, cell_type2) {
  img_name <- ppp_obj$Image

  if (sum(marks(ppp_obj) == cell_type1) == 0 || sum(marks(ppp_obj) == cell_type2) == 0) {
    warning(glue::glue("Skipping image {img_name} - missing {cell_type1} or {cell_type2}"))
    return(NULL)
  }

  K12 <- Kcross(ppp_obj, i = cell_type1, j = cell_type2, correction = "Ripley")
  L12 <- sqrt(K12$iso / pi) - K12$r
  # auc <- trapz(K12$r, L12)

  # Return long-form result (not wide)
  tibble::tibble(
    Image = img_name,
    r = K12$r,
    K12 = K12$iso,
    L12 = L12,
    # AUC_L12 = auc,
    cell_type1 = cell_type1,
    cell_type2 = cell_type2
  )
}

trapz <- function(x, y) {
  sum(diff(x) * (y[-length(y)] + y[-1]) / 2)
}




get_ripley_results <- function(ppp_list, wsi) {
  cell_pairs <- list(
    c("Epithelial", "Stroma"),
    c("Epithelial", "Immune"),
    c("Epithelial", "Lymph.Plasma"),
    c("Epithelial", "Lymphocyte"),
    c("Epithelial", "Plasma"),
    c("Immune", "Stroma"),
    c("Lymph.Plasma", "Stroma"),
    c("Lymphocyte", "Stroma"),
    c("Plasma", "Stroma")
  )

  pair_df <- tibble::tibble(
    cell_type1 = sapply(cell_pairs, `[[`, 1),
    cell_type2 = sapply(cell_pairs, `[[`, 2)
  )

  results_list <- purrr::pmap(pair_df, function(cell_type1, cell_type2) {
    # message(glue::glue("Computing Ripley for {cell_type1} vs {cell_type2}"))
    result_list <- lapply(ppp_list, calculate_ripley, cell_type1, cell_type2)
    bind_rows(Filter(Negate(is.null), result_list))
  })

  # Combine all results as long-format
  results_df <- bind_rows(results_list)
  if(nrow(results_df)>0){
    results_df <- results_df%>%
      mutate(r = round(r, digits = 1))%>%
      mutate(wsi = substr(Image,0,5))%>%
      mutate(cell_pair = paste0(cell_type1,"_",cell_type2))%>%
      select(-c(cell_type1,cell_type2, Image))%>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = cell_pair,
                   values_from = c(L12,K12),
                   names_glue = "Ripley_{.value}_{cell_pair}")
  
  

  }else{
    results_df <- data_frame()
  }

  return(results_df)
  
}

summarize_stats <- function(results_df, wsi_df){
  summary_stats <- results_df %>%
    mutate(across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ {
      .x[is.infinite(.x) | is.nan(.x)] <- NA_real_
      .x
    })) %>%
    group_by(wsi) %>%
    summarise(#across(starts_with("Ripley_K12_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_mean"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ trapz(r, .x), .names = "{col}_AUC"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_mean"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ max(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_max"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ min(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_min"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_sd"),
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ mean(.x > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{col}_frac_positive"),
              # auc area above zero - FIXED
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ {
                if(all(is.na(.x))) return(NA)
                pos_vals <- pmax(.x, 0, na.rm = TRUE)
                pos_indices <- !is.na(.x) & .x > 0
                if(sum(pos_indices, na.rm = TRUE) > 1) {
                  trapz(r[pos_indices], pos_vals[pos_indices])
                } else {
                  0
                }
              }, .names = "AUC_positive_{col}"),
              # Zero-crossing distance - FIXED
              across(starts_with("Ripley_L12_"), ~ {
                if(all(is.na(.x))) return(NA)
                valid_vals <- !is.na(.x)
                if(sum(valid_vals) < 2) return(NA)
                
                clean_vals <- .x[valid_vals]
                clean_r <- r[valid_vals]
                zero_crossings <- which(diff(sign(clean_vals)) != 0)
                if(length(zero_crossings) > 0) {
                  clean_r[zero_crossings[1] + 1]  
                } else {
                  NA_real_
                }
              }, .names = "{col}_zero_crossing"),
              .groups = "drop")

  summary_stats <- left_join(wsi_df, summary_stats, by = "wsi")
  return(summary_stats)
}
  
```




```{r}
ppp_list <- create_ppp_list(attn_cell)

# output <- get_ripley_results(ppp_list, attn_cell)
options(future.globals.maxSize = 1024 * 2^20)
plan(multisession, workers = 23)

process_ppp <- function(ppp_obj, attn_data) {
  tryCatch({
    get_ripley_results(list(ppp_obj), attn_data)
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(glue::glue("Error processing ppp for image {ppp_obj$Image}: {e$message}"))
    return(data.frame())  # Return empty data.frame instead of NULL
  })
}

results_lists <- future_map(ppp_list, ~ process_ppp(.x, wsi_df))
results <- results_lists %>%
  bind_rows()

summary_stats <- summarize_stats(results,wsi_df)
```

```{r plots}
ripley_plots_folder = file.path(BE_MASTER, "3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/plot/ripley/")

for (dataset_condition in c("all", "NU", "MDA")) {

  }
```

```{r plots attn1}


summary_stats_attn1<- read.csv(paste0(integration_intermediate_path, "ripley_summary_attn1.csv"))
summary_stats_attn1$attn <- 1
summary_stats_attn0<- read.csv(paste0(integration_intermediate_path, "ripley_summary_attn0.csv"))
summary_stats_attn0$attn <- 0

summary_stats_attn0vs1 <- bind_rows(summary_stats_attn1, summary_stats_attn0)%>%
  mutate(across(c("wsi", "progression", "pred", "dataset","attn"), as.factor))


```



```{r}
ripley_plots_folder = file.path(BE_MASTER, "3.integration/integration_project/spatial_analysis/plot/ripley/0vs1/")
# dir.create(ripley_plots_folder,showWarnings = TRUE, recursive = T)
mean_L12_columns <- names(summary_stats_attn0vs1)[grepl("^mean_L12", names(summary_stats_attn0vs1))]


for(pred in c(0,1)){
  
  for (col in mean_L12_columns) {
    
    # Initialize an empty list to store p-values
    pval_list <- list()
    
    # Loop through pred values (0 and 1)
    pval_df <- data.frame()
    for (progress_value in c(0, 1)) {
      
      # Filter the data for the current pred value
      filtered_data <- summary_stats_attn0vs1 %>%
        filter(progression == progress_value) %>%
        group_by(attn) %>%
        summarise(mean_L12 = list(get(col)), .groups = 'drop')
      
      # Perform the Wilcoxon test
      wilcox_test_result <- wilcox.test(filtered_data$mean_L12[[1]], filtered_data$mean_L12[[2]], paired = TRUE)
      pval_progress_df <- data.frame(
      group1 = progress_value - 0.19 + 1,  
      group2 = progress_value + 0.19 + 1,  
      p = wilcox_test_result$p.value, 
      label = paste("p =", format(wilcox_test_result$p.value, scientific = TRUE, digits=2))  # Format the p-values
    )
      pval_df <- bind_rows(pval_progress_df, pval_df)
    }
  
    
    # Create the boxplot with the p-value annotation
    plot <- ggplot(summary_stats_attn0vs1, aes_string(x = "pred", y = col)) +
      geom_boxplot(aes(fill = attn)) +
      stat_pvalue_manual(pval_df, y.position = max(summary_stats_attn0vs1[[col]], na.rm = TRUE) + 3, label = "label") 
      labs(title = paste("Boxplot for", col, " prediction ", pred), x = "Progression", y = col) +
      theme_minimal()
    
    # Save the plot
    ggsave(filename = paste0(ripley_plots_folder, "ripleyL_attn0vs1_pred",pred,"_", col, ".pdf"), plot = plot, width = 8, height = 6)
  }
}
```
